newsitem.title: ITALY: Treasury proposes board for Italy's Stet.
newsitem.headline: Treasury proposes board for Italy's Stet.

text.p: The Italian Treasury proposed 14 members for the board of state telecommunications holding Stet, including the new addition of Vito Gamberale, managing director of mobile phone group Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM).

Other new members proposed, including new chairman Guido Rossi and new managing director Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano, are Umberto Tracanella, Maurizio Decina, Augusto Zodda, Lucio Izzo, Nicola D'Angelo and Franco Corlaita.
Among current Stet board members proposed are Ruggero Boscu, Alessandro Ovi, Sergio Pivato, Maurizio Prato, Pietro Rastelli.
The Treasury is the majority shareholder in Stet, which it wants to merge with state telephone operator Telecom Italia by June at the latest before flotation of the new entity in autumn of this year.
The board proposal was made at Stet's shareholders meeting in Turin.
